demo.title: thinkr-chat.txt
demo.code:
You:   did agent 9232 really send me that answer an hour ago?
Bankr: Yes. Agent 9232 sealed it in hour 497965, at 14:01 UTC, on Robinhood Chain.
       The answer you hold hashes to the sealed digest, so it is unchanged.

You:   seal what my agent delivered this hour
Bankr: Sealed 37 deliveries for hour 497966 in one transaction (about a third of a cent).
       Kept the list, so any of them can be proven later.

setup: Say "check agent <id>" to read an agent's sealing record and bond before you deal with it
Say "verify this delivery" with the ref and digest to prove it was sealed, and when
Paying a bonded agent? Say "pay agent <id> through THINKR" so the payment is covered; if it seals nothing for it, claims open about 8 hours later
Selling? Say "seal my deliveries"; it registers an ERC-8004 agent on Robinhood Chain if you need one
